policy: These packs seed reference questions. They do not grant permission to copy third-party code, assets, layouts, screenshots, or brand styling.

packs.name: dashboard
packs.description: Operational dashboard references for decision hierarchy, data tables, and chart semantics.

sources.chosen_for: focus visibility, contrast, and non-color-only communication
sources.extract: states must be keyboard-visible, legible, and not color-only
sources.local_mapping: filter controls, chart legends, and active row states
sources.verification_gate: keyboard focus and contrast checks in rendered QA

sources.chosen_for: tables, chart hierarchy, and enterprise density
sources.extract: use clear hierarchy, explicit units, and predictable table behavior
sources.do_not_copy: Carbon brand skin or component code unless the project uses Carbon
sources.local_mapping: dashboard decision area, metric hierarchy, and tabular evidence
sources.verification_gate: focused chart/table screenshots and font-size consistency

sources.chosen_for: dense reading, hierarchy, and line-length judgment
sources.extract: typography must make scanning easier, not just larger
sources.local_mapping: title, metric, label, and table text roles
sources.verification_gate: visual audit for peer typography drift

packs.name: data-table
packs.description: Table and dense reference UI references for sorting, scanning, and row actions.

sources.source: WAI APG table/grid and disclosure guidance
sources.chosen_for: keyboard and semantic expectations
sources.extract: interactive grids need clear focus and predictable controls
sources.local_mapping: sort, filter, row expansion, and details controls
sources.verification_gate: open controls and inspect overlay/focus evidence

sources.chosen_for: filtering, sorting, pagination, density, and empty states
sources.extract: table controls should be visible, labeled, and near the data they affect
sources.do_not_copy: Cloudscape visual identity or code unless adopted
sources.local_mapping: table toolbar and state layout
sources.verification_gate: desktop and mobile screenshots of table controls

sources.chosen_for: labels and status words that work under pressure
sources.extract: language should be specific and unambiguous
sources.local_mapping: status labels, action text, and helper copy
sources.verification_gate: copy review for generic or ambiguous labels

packs.name: form-search-filter
packs.description: Search, filter, form, combobox, and overlay references.

sources.chosen_for: keyboard open/close, focus, and selection patterns
sources.extract: opened overlays must be reachable, visible, and dismissible
sources.local_mapping: search suggestions, theme pickers, filters, and menus
sources.verification_gate: active-state screenshot with overlay above adjacent containers

sources.chosen_for: input, select, popover, and listbox semantics
sources.extract: behavior and semantics are separable from visual skin
sources.do_not_copy: code unless dependency/license has been accepted
sources.local_mapping: search field and filter popover behavior
sources.verification_gate: keyboard and pointer state QA

sources.chosen_for: simple robust component decisions
sources.extract: visible affordances beat hidden cleverness
sources.local_mapping: dropdown affordance, focus treatment, and helper copy
sources.verification_gate: visual check for camouflaged controls

packs.name: mobile-card
packs.description: Mobile cards, lists, density, and responsive hierarchy references.

sources.source: WCAG reflow, target size, and focus guidance
sources.chosen_for: tap targets, overflow, text fit, and focus states
sources.extract: content must reflow without hiding controls or forcing horizontal scroll
sources.local_mapping: mobile list/card tap zones and text grouping
sources.verification_gate: 320/375/414-width rendered QA

sources.chosen_for: metadata placement, actions, and density
sources.extract: metadata should sit near the thing it describes
sources.do_not_copy: Material visual skin unless project uses Material
sources.local_mapping: image, title, metadata, score, and action grouping
sources.verification_gate: mobile screenshot inspection for related-item proximity

sources.chosen_for: touch-state feel and responsive transitions
sources.extract: motion should clarify state change and respect reduced motion
sources.local_mapping: card expansion, details reveal, and list state transitions
sources.verification_gate: reduced-motion and active-state QA when motion exists

packs.name: marketing-web
packs.description: Marketing/editorial references for first-viewport art direction and conversion flow.

sources.chosen_for: headings, landmarks, contrast, and responsive reading
sources.extract: visual drama cannot break reading order or legibility
sources.local_mapping: hero, navigation, CTA, and content sections
sources.verification_gate: mobile/desktop screenshots plus DOM audit

sources.chosen_for: avoiding generic hero/card scaffolds
sources.extract: choose a memorable composition or media treatment
sources.do_not_copy: screens, layouts, copy, assets, animation, or brand skins
sources.local_mapping: first-viewport signature move
sources.verification_gate: result cannot be mistaken for the reference

sources.chosen_for: reading rhythm and type hierarchy
sources.extract: type choices should fit the content and audience
sources.local_mapping: headline, subhead, body, and CTA hierarchy
sources.verification_gate: screenshot inspection for hierarchy and fit

packs.name: native-app
packs.description: Native iOS/Android references for platform conventions and visual QA.

sources.chosen_for: navigation, touch, Dynamic Type, and native controls
sources.extract: platform conventions beat imported web aesthetics
sources.do_not_copy: Apple app visuals or proprietary assets
sources.local_mapping: iOS screen hierarchy and interaction states
sources.verification_gate: simulator screenshots and hierarchy evidence

sources.chosen_for: Material components, state layers, typography, and motion
sources.extract: Android UI must work across font scale, IME, light, and dark
sources.local_mapping: Compose/View hierarchy and controls
sources.verification_gate: emulator screenshots, UI tree, logs, and profile coverage

sources.chosen_for: mobile transition critique
sources.extract: motion should communicate state and hierarchy
sources.local_mapping: screen transition and control feedback
sources.verification_gate: reduced-motion and interaction review

packs.name: motion
packs.description: Motion references for timelines, interruption, reduced motion, and visual polish.

sources.source: MDN CSS animation, transition, and Web Animations docs
sources.chosen_for: performant, interruptible, accessible motion
sources.extract: motion must support reduced-motion preferences
sources.local_mapping: transition and state-change behavior
sources.verification_gate: reduced-motion and no-jank checks

sources.chosen_for: sequenced or scroll-driven animation
sources.extract: use a timeline when coordination is the actual requirement
sources.do_not_copy: demo designs or proprietary plugin usage without license review
sources.local_mapping: choreographed reveal, chart transition, or guided attention
sources.verification_gate: animation state QA and performance review

sources.chosen_for: microinteraction vocabulary and restraint
sources.extract: motion should make the interface easier to understand
sources.local_mapping: hover, focus, drawer, card, and navigation transitions
sources.verification_gate: state video/screenshot notes when motion is material
